properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured), SECOND SIGHTING of the qs 2026-09-04 gap: a run has exactly one machine-read outcome (Verification.status), and every rollup reads only that. `findings` carries the qualification ("31/35, the 4 are the intended tightening") where no computation and no list view looks. Nothing else on the surface holds per-assertion outcomes
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL on dev_storyflow's 2026-09-25 entry (storyflow #654, session 3bd108ab), triage of 2026-09-28.

① OBSERVED, verbatim: "`add_verification` takes one `status` for a run. My walk ended 31/35: the 4 'failures' were the intended tightening, which a parity check proved. `passing` overstates that and `failing` misreports it, and there is nowhere to say 'passing, with 4 expected-change assertions'. I put the reconciliation in `findings`, but a list view shows only the status." NOT affected: a run that is wholly passing or wholly failing.

② PRECEDENT: fact:defect-a-verification-cannot-record-a-partly-blocked-run (qs project, 2026-09-04) records the same gap in a different shape. There, a run proved everything the project owns and was blocked elsewhere. It noted that "`partial` WOULD OWE EVERY READER A RULING", and was left at n=1. chg:absence-means-nobody-said-on-a-verification-and-a-plan-holds-a-check-and-a-ruling (2026-09-06) says "whether qs's 'partial verification status' needs MORE ... remains the open idea it was", but no exploratory Decision was ever minted for it. Adjacent open idea: dec:idea-a-finding-carries-its-bounds (a `grade` plus structured results). ⇒ This is sighting TWO, from a second project, in a second shape: an expected change rather than a blockage.

③ CANDIDATES: (a) SCHEMA — the status enum has no qualified outcome, and status is the only field rollups read (the reporter's and qs's reading). (b) DISCOVERABILITY — a per-assertion or per-part home exists and was missed, as happened three times in the 09-08 triage. (c) THE OBSERVATION IS WRONG — the 4 are STALE EXPECTATIONS. The check as written is failing, and the honest record is to update the 4 assertions (the tightening's ChangeEvent retiring the old expectations) and re-run to 35/35. (d) READ SIDE ONLY — the data is fine and only the list views drop it.

④ DISCRIMINATOR: (b) predicts some typed field or edge carries per-part outcomes. (d) predicts the rollups would show `findings` if they read it, with the schema adequate. (a) predicts neither.

⑤ RESULT, reflow2-mcp 0.72.0, scratch store: status "partial" was REFUSED, with the enum as ["planned","passing","failing","skipped","blocked","superseded"]. For (b), the candidates were read and none fits. reconcile_verification's `observed` and `observed_by_file` report one outcome PER CHECK (a check covered by two files "takes the worst outcome"). VERIFIES.coverage (full/partial/smoke) and set_evidence_scope's pinned/swept are SCOPE, not outcome. INVALIDATES from the tightening's ChangeEvent retires the WHOLE check. ⇒ (b) is REFUTED. For (d), measured: with the walk recorded passing plus findings "31/35 …", loop_status.verifications gave by_status {passing: 1}, and the walk was absent from `attention` (which lists failing and never-run checks). scan_nodes {brief: true} rendered name + status only. ⇒ the qualification reaches no rollup, as the reporter said. (a) HOLDS. (c) CANNOT BE SEPARATED from (a) here. Both predict the same observation, and whether the 4 should have been rewritten is the reporter's call about their own check. Even under (c), the retirement can only be stated for the whole check, never for 4 of its 35 assertions.

⑥ CLASS: the machine-read field and the human-read field disagree, and nothing joins them. It is the axis of fact:defect-a-status-can-advance-past-its-own-prose-and-nothing-says-so, seen from the other side. The qs report ran into it through a blockage, this report through an intended change. Would a fix at the class have covered both? Only a fix that gives the rollups a structured qualifier. A new status word alone owes every reader a ruling, as the qs record already warned.

PINNING TEST (not written; the form awaits the owner's ruling on dec:idea-a-run-can-pass-with-its-exceptions-stated): whatever shape is chosen, a qualified run is (i) never counted as a plain pass by loop_status, coverage_report or the unproven-capability gap without saying so, and (ii) rendered with its qualifier in loop_status's verification digest. Both fail today.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether storyflow's 4 assertions should have been rewritten rather than reported (their check); how often the shape occurs beyond n=2; whether graph_report {include_verifications: true} renders `findings` (not run).

REPORTER'S CONCLUSIONS: "one status for a run" HOLDS. "nowhere to say 'passing, with 4 expected-change assertions'" HOLDS, since no field or edge carries per-assertion outcomes. "a list view shows only the status" HOLDS for loop_status and scan_nodes brief. The idea is recorded as dec:idea-a-run-can-pass-with-its-exceptions-stated.
